DSG ADV Riding Jacket

A lightweight dual-sport adventure touring jacket, with unparalleled mobility and airflow.
A super versatile riding jacket, that is here to solve all your problems on an adventure keeping you safe and comfortable throughout, making it the only riding jacket you will ever need. The Adventure riding jacket is constructed with 900D polyester fabric. The Adventure riding jacket has large 3D air mesh panels which paired with a comfort fit optimize internal airflow around the body.

The Adventure riding jacket is equipped with detachable sleeves which can be stowed in a large pocket at the back of the riding jacket. An internal hydration pocket offers the option of inserting a bladder (upto 2L). The jacket has two large pockets in the front with a Napoleon chest pocket. Since it is an adventure touring jacket it has an array of reflective details which are strategically placed around the jacket to aid night time visibility.

The DSG Adventure riding jacket comes equipped with a trick up its sleeve. To make your adventure more comfortable, safe and active, the DSG BIONIC Jacket, which comes with the DSG Adventure jacket offers impact protection. It has a snug fit to keep the protectors in place in even the most active situations. The DSG BIONIC is equipped with DSG FLEXION protectors which mold around your body and are CE LEVEL 2 approved.

title: DSG RACE PRO V2 PANTS (BLACK)
description:
DSG RACE PRO V2 PANTS

description:
DSG Phoenix Air Riding Gloves Entry-level gloves, premium protection. Don’t let “entry-level” fool you. Packed with advanced protection and wrapped.

Don’t let “entry-level” fool you. Packed with advanced protection and wrapped in a stylish design, the Phoenix Air Gloves are built for urban riders who demand both safety and comfort. Protection

  • TPU hard knuckle protector for enhanced impact resistance
  • EVA foam palm slider for additional protection during slides and impacts
  • Maze-pattern heat-stamped palm enhances abrasion and cut resistance

  • Slim wrist construction offers a clean fit inside riding jacket sleeves

title: DSG Hydro V2 Glove (Black Fluro Yellow)
description:
DSG Hydro V2
The DSG Hydro V2 Waterproof Touring glove is a performance riding glove packed with protective features such as new knuckle protector. Featuring DSG 100% waterproof and breathable performance technology for effective all-weather protection and a reduced material design offering superior sensitivity on the bike’s controls.

CONSTRUCTION:

OUTER SHELL MATERIAL

  • Constructed from a supple and highly durable Leather and PU chassis to provide core abrasion resistance and durability.
  • Leather on palm for superior abrasion resistance in a key area.
  • Advanced poly-textile reinforcements on palm and thumb provides superior grip on bike’s controls.
  • Aniline leather reinforced outer hand with padding on landing zones provide maximum abrasion resistance.
  • DSG developed ergonomic stretch insert between thumb and palm offers flexibility to vastly improve hand movement.
  • Durable new flexible DSG knuckle protection provides class-leading impact and abrasion protection.

FEATURES:

  • Waterproof performance HIPORA membrane developed by KOLON has 4 seemingly contrary characteristics which are Moisture Permeability, Water Resistancy, Breathability and water Repellency.
  • HIPORA has solved the biggest problem inherent in the conventional waterproof film. HIPORA has the secret in the unique polyurethane coating technology.
  • That Is Numerous numbers of micro pores (about. 9 billions/ 1 inch2) of the minimal size (60.1-3u) are placed all over the polyurethane coated film.
  • They shut out the water from outside, but allow the moisture or warm steam from the body go out. When the body perspires from strenuous work on exercise the perspiration easily escapes leaving the wearer feeling comfortable.
  • Touchscreen compatible fingertip area on index for use with smartphones and GPS systems

PROTECTION

  • Palm, fingers and backhand padded with energy absorbing EVA foam for improved comfort and fit.
  • Adjustable double hook and loop closure on cuff and wrist keeps glove safely and securely in position.
  • Finger-bridge prevents excessive finger roll and separation during impacts.
  • Printed logos for weight-saving and material integrity.
  • DSG Hydro V2 glove is CE Approved.
